Story: Once there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big red ball that she loved to play with every day. One sunny day, Lily saw her friend Timmy sitting alone on the grass. Timmy looked sad because his toy car was broken. Lily thought for a moment and then had a bright idea. She ran over to Timmy and said, Let's play with my ball together!  Timmy's face lit up with a big smile. They played catch, laughed, and ran around in circles until the sun began to set. Lily felt happy because she saw Timmy happy. They both learned that playing together was much more fun. From that day on, they always shared their toys and had many fun days in the sun. Lily knew that being kind and sharing was the best way to make everyone smile.

Story: Max loved playing in the park. One day, he saw a shiny red ball high up on a tree. He tried to reach it, but it was too high. Max got angry and hit the tree. No, Max! his friend Sam said. Be kind. Let’s ask the ball to come down. Sam climbed up and gently brought the ball down. Max smiled and said, Thank you, Sam. They played together and shared the ball. Max learned to be kind, not angry.
